title: Using ATMs worldwide
summary: Explains how to use a Purple Account debit card at ATMs worldwide: a $1,000 daily ATM withdrawal limit (all withdrawals in a 24-hour period), monthly ATM operator fee rebates capped at $30, and when rebates post/are credited. Includes abroad withdrawal best practices and troubleshooting steps for missing rebates.
